title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under social influence, policy enforcement, media messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals update their mask attitude and propensity to comply based on observed behaviors and norms of social neighbors.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask policies, affecting the likelihood that entering individuals wear masks and imposing penalties for non-compliance.

interactions.name: media_influence
interactions.description: Media channels broadcast messages that shift risk perception, perceived efficacy of masks, and perceived social norms.

interactions.name: mask_purchasing
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers subject to price, income, demand, and inventory availability.

interactions.name: movement_between_locations
interactions.description: Individuals follow daily schedules (home, work/school, transit, retail, public spaces) and face context-dependent mask requirements.

interactions.name: supply_chain_restocking
interactions.description: Retailers restock inventory based on restock rates and lead times, influencing availability and prices.

interactions.name: public_campaigns
interactions.description: Government conducts campaigns to increase adoption, modify attitudes, and adjust norms over time.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: contextual_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Mask-wearing rate by location type (e.g., transit, workplace, retail).

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Time (days) to reach specified adoption thresholds (e.g., 50%, 70%).

metrics.name: sustained_adoption
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the final N days to assess stability.

metrics.name: inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across demographic groups (e.g., age, income).

metrics.name: stockout_frequency
metrics.description: Fraction of days with retailer stockouts affecting purchasing.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to policy changes, controlling for other factors.
